## FAQ

## How do you ensure data security during the ITAD process?

We adhere to strict data sanitization and destruction protocols, using advanced technologies and
methods such as secure erase, degaussing, and physical shredding. Our processes are certified by
NAID and compliant with NIST 800-88 guidelines.

## What happens to the assets after data destruction?

After data sanitization, we thoroughly inspect and refurbish assets for remarketing, helping to
maximize their residual value. Assets that cannot be reused are responsibly recycled in accordance
with e-waste regulations, with a focus on recovering raw materials and minimizing environmental
impact.

## How do you help clients maintain regulatory compliance?

We stay up-to-date with the latest e-waste and data privacy regulations, such as HIPAA, FACTA, and
GDPR, and ensure that our processes are fully compliant. We provide detailed audit trails,
certificates of data destruction, and other necessary documentation to help clients demonstrate
compliance.

## What kind of reporting and documentation do you provide?

We offer comprehensive reporting and documentation, including asset inventory reports, data
destruction certificates, environmental impact reports, and more. Our reporting is customizable to
meet each client's specific needs and is accessible through our secure online portal.

## Can you tailor your ITAD services to our company's specific needs?

Absolutely. We understand that every organization has unique ITAD requirements, and we work closely
with each client to develop customized solutions that align with their specific needs, goals, and
compliance obligations.

## What is your company's coverage area, and how do you ensure timely service?

We serve clients throughout the United States, Canada and Europe with certified processing

## Why Do I Pheel This Way? Episode 3: Finding Strength Through Sports While Living with
## Phenylketonuria

Sports can be a powerful source of confidence and connection for teens – but for those living with
PKU, staying active often requires extra planning, discipline and self-care. Episode 3 explores how
teens with PKU balance the demands and realities of athletics while managing this metabolic
condition. 

[READ MORE][37]

[Devesh Radhakrishnan]

## From Unexpected Turns to Purposeful Impact

purpose and patient impact that continue to inspire his work. 

[READ MORE][38]

[lab image]

## BioMarin Announces Positive Phase 3 Pivotal Study Results in Children with Hypochondroplasia

Read our press release to learn more about the positive topline results from a Phase 3 pivotal study
in children with hypochondroplasia, a genetic skeletal condition for which there are currently no
approved treatments. 

[READ MORE][39]

## Breakthrough Science

We relentlessly pursue bold science to translate genetic discoveries into new medicines that advance
the future of human health.

[Learn More][40]

[Kennedy "KK" Davlin]

## Focus on Patients

We listen to and learn from patient communities to collaborate on solutions with the potential to
help improve care.

[Learn More][41]

[Javier Femenia]

## People-First Culture

Our talented and dedicated people represent the best the biotech industry has to offer and have
helped shape a culture focused on working together to deliver for the patients we serve.

[Learn More][42]

## BioMarin is a leading, global rare disease biotechnology company focused on delivering medicines
## for people living with genetically defined conditions.

Founded in 1997, we have a proven track record of innovation, with nine commercial therapies and a
strong clinical and preclinical pipeline. Using a distinctive approach to drug discovery and
development, BioMarin seeks to unleash the full potential of genetic science by pursuing
category-defining medicines that have a profound impact on patients.

We provide high-quality microalgae products for health and nutrition in a sustainable and

# Creating smarter ways to fight bacteria

##### Leading the advancement of technologies and products that break up biofilms and destroy
##### bacteria.

##### Kane Biotech has developed new technologies and innovations leading to a portfolio of patents
##### and patents pending that focus primarily on biofilm.

Kane Biotech is a biotechnology company engaged in the research, development and commercialization
of technologies and products that prevent and remove microbial biofilms. The Company has a portfolio
of proprietary products ready for commercialization and products in development.

revyve™, revyve^{®}, coactiv+™, coactiv+^{®}, and DispersinB^{®} are trademarks of Kane Biotech Inc.
The Company is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol “KNE”. Kane Biotech is also
listed on the US OTC under the symbol "KNBIF".

## Understanding Biofilms

The study of biofilms has increased significantly in recent years due to the growing awareness of
the pervasiveness and impact of biofilms on human and animal health, as well as natural and
industrial systems.

## Wound Gel
* The revyve^{®} Antimicrobial Wound Gel is a combination of Kane’s patented coactiv+^{®} technology
  in a thermo-reversible gel that provides a moist environment best suited for wound healing.
* revyve™ Antimicrobial Wound Gel undergoes a reversible transformation from liquid to gel with
  temperature. This allows the wound gel to be easily applied, stay on the wound, and easy to rinse
  off, making it ideal for sensitive wounds.
* Accessible for patients. The revyve^{®} Antimicrobial Wound Gel fits within US reimbursement - one
  of the ONLY wound gels within reimbursement.

# Creating smarter ways to fight bacteria

##### Leading the advancement of technologies and products that break up biofilms and destroy
##### bacteria.

##### Kane Biotech has developed new technologies and innovations leading to a portfolio of patents
##### and patents pending that focus primarily on biofilm.

Kane Biotech is a biotechnology company engaged in the research, development and commercialization
of technologies and products that prevent and remove microbial biofilms. The Company has a portfolio
of proprietary products ready for commercialization and products in development.

revyve™, revyve^{®}, coactiv+™, coactiv+^{®}, and DispersinB^{®} are trademarks of Kane Biotech Inc.
The Company is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol “KNE”. Kane Biotech is also
listed on the US OTC under the symbol "KNBIF".

## Current Wound Care &
## Surgical Products

[Wound Care: revyve^{®} Antimicrobial Wound Gel][26]

[Burns: revyve^{®} Antimicrobial Wound Gel Spray][27]

## Products in Development

Wound Care: revyve^{®} Antimicrobial Skin and Wound Cleanser

Surgical: coactiv+^{®} Antimicrobial Surgical Hydrogel

Surgical: DispersinB^{®} Hydrogel

Acne: DispersinB^{®} Acne Cleanser

## Understanding Biofilms

The study of biofilms has increased significantly in recent years due to the growing awareness of
the pervasiveness and impact of biofilms on human and animal health, as well as natural and
industrial systems.

## revyve^{®} Antimicrobial
## Wound Gel
* The revyve^{®} Antimicrobial Wound Gel is a combination of Kane’s patented coactiv+^{®} technology
  in a thermo-reversible gel that provides a moist environment best suited for wound healing.
* revyve™ Antimicrobial Wound Gel undergoes a reversible transformation from liquid to gel with
  temperature. This allows the wound gel to be easily applied, stay on the wound, and easy to rinse
  off, making it ideal for sensitive wounds.
* Accessible for patients. The revyve^{®} Antimicrobial Wound Gel fits within US reimbursement - one
  of the ONLY wound gels within reimbursement.

[revyve.ca][28] [revyvegel.com][29]

*Renderings shown are for illustrations purpose only. *

*Renderings shown are for illustrations purpose only.*

## revyve^{®} Antimicrobial
## Wound Gel Spray
* Novel non-aerosol spray application offering zero-contact treatment that can be rapidly applied to
  traumatic, large surface and hard to reach wounds.
* Thick gel spray that strongly adheres to and stays in place on wounds.
* Designed for painless delivery and removal of gel.
* Patent pending.

# Innovative marine biotechnologies

Marinova is an Australian biotechnology company dedicated to the development and production of high
purity seaweed extracts for the betterment of human health. We specialise in the research,
development and manufacture of [fucoidan ][41]compounds – highly bioactive polysaccharides derived
from select species of brown seaweed.­

As the global leader in fucoidan science, Marinova is the supplier of choice to world-renowned
research institutions. Our reputation is built on the unrivalled quality and efficacy of our
bioactive fucoidan extracts and two decades of rigorous scientific investigation. 

Marinova’s global research and development program welcomes [collaborators][42] that share our
mindset for scientific innovation. Our highly characterised fucoidan fractions are well-suited to
medical device applications and pharmaceutical research.

Marinova is also home to the unique range of [Maritech^{®} organic fucoidan ][43]extracts - high
purity fucoidans developed specifically for nutritional, cosmetic and animal health applications.

**Marinova: Pure Source, Pure Science.**

#### FAQs

###### Looking for answers?

Visit our [FAQ page][62] to learn more about the company and how our seaweed blend fit into your
feeding programs.

###### Can customers order samples?

Yes. Samples are available for evaluation or feed trials.

###### How is pricing defined?

Prices (ExW Vietnam or ExW Netherlands) are reviewed quarterly based on raw material and logistics
costs.

###### How do you manage shipping and logistics?

We are not a logistics company; however, we assist and support our customers throughout the shipping
process to help ensure efficient transit times and competitive freight rates. All shipments are
conducted in accordance with Incoterms 2020.

The **Australia New Zealand Marine Biotechnology Society (ANZMBS)** is the leading voice for marine
biotechnology across Australasia. We connect scientists, industry, policy makers, and innovators to
advance the sustainable use of marine resources for the benefit of people, the planet, and the blue
economy.

Our mission is to foster collaboration, innovation, and education in marine biotechnology, from
fundamental research to real-world applications. We help to foster partnerships with academia,
industry, Indigenous communities, and international networks to promote responsible and impactful
marine biotechnology across the region.

[ See the Official Conference Website ][21]

# **Save the Date - Mark your Calendars**

We’re thrilled to announce the 6th Australia New Zealand Marine Biotechnology Society Conference!

Join us as we bring together researchers, industry, and innovators to shape the future of marine
biotechnology for hands on workshops, inspiring talks, and show off the Tauranga Moana on exciting
field trips.

Mark your calendars and book those flights - **early bird tickets are now live!**

**26–28 August 2026
Tauranga, New Zealand
The University of Waikato**

Three full days of engaging sessions and interactive activities
* Workshops
* Welcome function
* Marae visit to Huria Marae for an enriching cultural experience, includes bus transfer and morning

* In person or virtual cultural tours of the University of Waikato - Tauranga Campus
* Access to the student poster session
* Access to bookable hands-on skill sharing workshops - EOI expression now available
* Dinner at Tauranga’s stunning waterfront venue, The Cargo Shed
* All catering throughout the conference

**We are a membership-based society, and by joining us you will gain a gateway to a global Marine
Biotechnology network.**

**Member benefits include:**

• Networking with members through online workshops, and networking events to strengthen
collaboration and knowledge exchange.

• Up-to-date information on society activities and the opportunity to feed-in to those affecting the
marine biotechnology community across Australia and New Zealand, through our quarterly newsletter
and LinkedIn

• Conferences regularly held across Australia and New Zealand, membership includes a conference
discount

• Discounted rates in key journals in the field that are affiliated with the society

• Invite to our AGM

Aquapharm - Products Information & News

## Aquapharm is an innovative discovery company pioneering the development of new breakthrough
## products founded on the vast, untapped diversity of marine micro-organisms.

The company's goal is to harness this resource to rapidly develop next generation pharmaceuticals
and novel, naturally derived functional food and personal care ingredients and products.

Founded in Scotland in 2000, Aquapharm Bio-Discovery is one of the first UK marine biotechnology
companies that provides new 'bio-prospecting' approaches to source novel natural products from
marine microbes.

The Company utilizes its proprietary knowledge and specialist skills to discover, isolate and
culture marine bacteria and fungi as potential new sources of valuable pharmaceutical compounds and
industrial biologically derived products

The evolution of new technologies and our growing understanding of biodiversity allows them to
provide a better platform than chemical synthesis alone to discover novel solutions to drug
development.

76% of all man's currently available pharmaceutical products have been derived from natural sources.
The marine environment offers the best and highest chance of the discovery of natural products for
the 21st century.

AquaPharm is actively engaged in exploiting the vast opportunity of new drug discovery from marine
organisms. To date, only 5% of the marine environment has been described and it is estimated that
between 500,000 - 5,000,000 (mostly micro-organisms) species remain to be discovered, representing a
huge opportunity in the unearthing of new drug leads. By utilising its specialist knowledge of
culturing and the fermentation of marine bacteria and fungi, AquaPharm intends to identify new
antibiotics, anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer drugs capable of meeting unmet clinical needs of the
pharmaceutical and industrial markets.

AquaPharm is also exploiting its science to develop commercial benefits in high yield
bio-manufacture of nutraceuticals (vitamins, anti-oxidants and blocking agents) and industrial
compounds (pigments, cosmetics and bio-catalysts).

## Marine biotechnology company harnessing marine micro-organisms to develop high value products for
## application across the pharmaceutical, personal care and nutrition sectors.

The company is based at the [European Centre for Marine Biotechnology][8] in Oban, Scotland with a
corporate office and labs in Edinburgh.

Central to the company is its development of new pharmaceuticals from its marine microbial
collection to address areas of high unmet medical need including auto-immune diseases; tissue-damage
caused by chronic and degenerative diseases and; antibiotics to treat drug-resistant infections.

Through a unified approach to the discovery of new functional actives, Aquapharm recognises that its
collection of marine microbes also holds great potential for the food, beverage and personal care
sectors and its Oceanx business unit is actively working with strategic partners to bring novel,
scientifically backed ingredients and products to these markets.

These product development strategies are underpinned by the company's unique ability to culture,
harvest and intelligently screen its microbial collection through an integrated discovery platform
that includes proprietary induction technologies such as SeaRch™.

The company is currently advancing a strong pipeline of new chemistry leads...

Aquapharm - Products Information & News

## Aquapharm is an innovative discovery company pioneering the development of new breakthrough
## products founded on the vast, untapped diversity of marine micro-organisms.

The company's goal is to harness this resource to rapidly develop next generation pharmaceuticals
and novel, naturally derived functional food and personal care ingredients and products.

Founded in Scotland in 2000, Aquapharm Bio-Discovery is one of the first UK marine biotechnology
companies that provides new 'bio-prospecting' approaches to source novel natural products from
marine microbes.

The Company utilizes its proprietary knowledge and specialist skills to discover, isolate and
culture marine bacteria and fungi as potential new sources of valuable pharmaceutical compounds and
industrial biologically derived products

The evolution of new technologies and our growing understanding of biodiversity allows them to
provide a better platform than chemical synthesis alone to discover novel solutions to drug
development.

76% of all man's currently available pharmaceutical products have been derived from natural sources.
The marine environment offers the best and highest chance of the discovery of natural products for
the 21st century.

AquaPharm is actively engaged in exploiting the vast opportunity of new drug discovery from marine
organisms. To date, only 5% of the marine environment has been described and it is estimated that
between 500,000 - 5,000,000 (mostly micro-organisms) species remain to be discovered, representing a
huge opportunity in the unearthing of new drug leads. By utilising its specialist knowledge of
culturing and the fermentation of marine bacteria and fungi, AquaPharm intends to identify new
antibiotics, anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer drugs capable of meeting unmet clinical needs of the
pharmaceutical and industrial markets.

AquaPharm is also exploiting its science to develop commercial benefits in high yield
bio-manufacture of nutraceuticals (vitamins, anti-oxidants and blocking agents) and industrial
compounds (pigments, cosmetics and bio-catalysts).

## Marine biotechnology company harnessing marine micro-organisms to develop high value products for
## application across the pharmaceutical, personal care and nutrition sectors.

The company is based at the [European Centre for Marine Biotechnology][8] in Oban, Scotland with a
corporate office and labs in Edinburgh.

Central to the company is its development of new pharmaceuticals from its marine microbial
collection to address areas of high unmet medical need including auto-immune diseases; tissue-damage
caused by chronic and degenerative diseases and; antibiotics to treat drug-resistant infections.

Through a unified approach to the discovery of new functional actives, Aquapharm recognises that its
collection of marine microbes also holds great potential for the food, beverage and personal care
sectors and its Oceanx business unit is actively working with strategic partners to bring novel,
scientifically backed ingredients and products to these markets.

These product development strategies are underpinned by the company's unique ability to culture,
harvest and intelligently screen its microbial collection through an integrated discovery platform
that includes proprietary induction technologies such as SeaRch™.

# Caltron Clays & Chemicals

Caltron Clays & Chemicals Pvt Ltd is No.1 Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic Raw Material manufacturers and
suppliers in India. Caltron Clays is an ISO 9001 Certified & CRISIL rated company, the only of its
kind in the minerals industry. Caltron Clays is a recognized export house specializing in the
processing and export of mineral, oxide, and chemicals.

[View Our Products][10]

## About Caltron

CALTRON is proudly celebrating its 26th year of successful operations having established a strong
reputation as a world-class manufacturer of natural calcium sources. Over the years, the company has
earned the trust of global customers through its unwavering commitment to quality innovation and
excellence.

Caltron proudly holds an extensive range of internationally recognized certifications including ISO
9001, ISO 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 18001, HACCP, HALAL, KOSHER, VEGAN, ECOCERT ORGANIC, SMETA 4 Pillar,
WHO-GMP compliance and DUNS registration. These certifications reflect the company’s dedication to
maintaining the highest standards across quality safety sustainability and ethical business
practices.

Guided by its tagline A Compliment to Supplement Caltron continues to deliver premium-quality
natural ingredients to customers worldwide. With its corporate office located in Mumbai India and a
state-of-the-art manufacturing site in India, the company serves a diverse range of industries with
natural mineral sources and natural cosmetic ingredients tailored to evolving market needs.

## We Have Built an Enviable Reputation

9

#### Products

We manufacture pharmaceutical raw materials, cosmetic raw materials, oil and gas drilling chemicals,
minerals, and animal feed supplements.

9

#### Markets

Our major market encompasses Caribbean, South/West Africa, North Europe, Middle East, South/West
Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America.

9

#### Vision

Caltron was visualized by Mr. S.N. JAIN the Managing Director of the company who molded the success
of the company.

## Our Products Range

[[Pharmaceutical Raw Materials | Caltron Clays]][11]

#### [Pharmaceutical Raw Materials][12]

Caltron Clays is a top Pharmaceutical Raw Materials manufacturing company and supplier in India.
Caltron is the leading manufacturer of Algae Calcium Powder or Algae Calcium Carbonate in India.
Caltron competes globally with the best available calcium sources in the world. Caltron Clays
supplies Pharmaceutical Raw Materials worldwide.

[[Cosmetic Raw Materials | Caltron Clays]][13]

#### [Cosmetic Raw Materials][14]

Caltron Clays is a top Cosmetic Raw Materials manufacturing company and supplier in India. Caltron
Clays & Chemicals is one of the renowned names in Cosmetic Industry for the Cosmetic Raw Materials
and their “Quality & Standards”. Caltron Clays supplies Cosmetic Raw Materials worldwide.

# Product’s and Services at per International Standards

We provide innovative product solutions for sustainable progress. Our professional team works to
increase productivity and cost effectiveness on the market.

[About Us][15]

### Expanding**
### beyond imagination**

We are a company driven by values, knowledge, and relationships. We invest in customer relationships
and strive hard to grow it by delivering quality results and customer service. Our satisfied
clientele is the most important contributors to our success. We have successfully built long and
mutually beneficial relationships with our international clients in over 40 countries worldwide. Our
services are at par with international standards.

[Pharmaceutical Raw Material Manufacturer | Caltron CLays]
[Cosmetic Raw Materials Manufacturer | Caltron Clays]

### Our Skill**
### What We Achieved**

We achieved recognition in U.K, Italy, Germany, Belgium, USA, Japan, Canada, Kenya, Ghana, Tanzania,
South Africa, Saudi Arabia, Philippines, UAE, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, etc

## Our Reach

## We Are Certified

Caltron Clays & Chemicals Pvt Ltd is No.1 Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic Raw Material manufacturers and
suppliers in India. Our guiding principle is to provide total customer satisfaction and improve the
quality of our products and services.

### R&D Decision Makers

We provide R&D decision makers with access to accurate, connected data so they can quickly

We help Innovation teams discover the emerging technology areas, evaluate technological maturity,

We accelerate the research process for Technology Research Analysts through automated analysis of
millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

We help Business Development teams identify startups and new entrants with disruptive technologies,
and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.
Equipped with these insights, BD teams can make informed decisions about which companies to
collaborate with.

Discovery brings company, patent, literature, investment, M&A, news, and research funding together
in one platform. Powered by AI and machine learning, the platform is continually updated with the
latest global data points.These connected insights provide a meaningful foundation for you to
analyze and make sense of market trends, disruptive technology, the competitive landscape, and more.

### Technology Classification and Company Innovation Indicators

With our technology classification and ranking system, we help you quickly understand a company's
R&D strategy through patent portfolio and technology roadmap visualizations. This data empowers you
to measure a company’s innovation capability, technical influence, innovation originality, scale,
and stability.
[AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Radar]

### AI-powered Competitive Intelligence Radar

you don’t miss important insights that could impact your innovation strategy.

Welcome to EnvironmentalScience.org, your go-to resource for a fulfilling career in environmental
science. We understand that your green passion for the environment is not just a passing interest.
It's a significant part of who you are.

## What is Environmental Science?

*Environmental science integrates ecology, biology, zoology, oceanography, atmospheric science, soil
science, geology, chemistry, and more to study how natural and human-made processes interact and
ultimately affect Earth's biomes.*

Environmental scientists aren't just professionals; they're individuals like you who care about the
Earth and its resources. They play diverse roles, including [Environmental Lawyers,][129] [Coral
Reef Sanctuary Managers][130], Antarctic Researchers, Laboratory Technicians, [Wastewater
Technicians][131], and [Solar Panel Engineers][132].

They obtain their positions through various educational paths, with degrees in environmental
science, [studies][133], [policy][134], and [management][135]—emphasizing that there's more than one
path to a career in environmental science. Programs are offered at many colleges and universities in
the United States and Canada as well as throughout the world. Many students who begin in a different
major go on to pursue an environmental degree in graduate school.

## Environmental Science Degree Programs

Choosing the right school is a critical decision, as not all Environmental Science programs are
created equal. Some may be a better fit for you than others. Our comprehensive guide serves as your
compass, addressing key questions and financial aid options.

### Understanding Degree Levels

Environmental science programs span from bachelor's degrees through doctoral programs, each serving
different career goals and timelines.

────────┬───────────┬───────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────
Degree  │Typical    │Career Outcomes                        │Best For

────────┼───────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────
Bachelor│4 years    │Entry-level scientist, technician,     │Students beginning environmental       
's      │           │field researcher                       │science careers                        
────────┼───────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────
Master's│2 years    │Specialized roles, project management, │Career advancement, specialization,    
        │           │research leadership                    │leadership positions                   
────────┼───────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────
PhD     │4-6 years  │University professor, senior           │Academic careers, high-level research, 
        │           │researcher, policy advisor             │thought leadership                     
────────┴───────────┴───────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────

### Key Factors in Choosing a Program

For comprehensive information on [environmental science degree programs][136], including bachelor's,
master's, and PhD options, explore our detailed program guides. Many students also pursue [online
environmental science degrees][137] to balance education with work or family commitments.

*Consider what matters to you:*
* In-person, online classes, or both
* Future career prospects
* Available programs and specializations
* Geographic proximity—a school near you
* Program offerings—certificates, majors, 5-year master's degree programs
* Affordability and financial aid options
* Opportunity to collaborate with respected professors

### Finding the Right Program

When evaluating programs, consider these essential elements:
* **Choosing the right college program:** Discover the crucial factors in selecting the ideal
  college degree program that aligns with your environmental aspirations.
* **Education requirements:** Understand the academic path required to enter the field.
* **Featured programs from renowned institutions:** Find programs from prestigious institutions like
  Johns Hopkins University, Calvin University, Southern New Hampshire University, Arizona State
  University - Online, and the University of Phoenix. These programs span various areas such as
  Environmental Science, Energy Policy, Climate, GIS, and more.
* **Scholarships and grants:** Learn about financial aid options to support your educational
  journey.
* **Internship opportunities:** Find valuable hands-on experiences to enhance your skills and
  knowledge.

Environmental scientists aren't just professionals; they're individuals like you who care about the
Earth and its resources. They play diverse roles, including [Environmental Lawyers,][129] [Coral
Reef Sanctuary Managers][130], Antarctic Researchers, Laboratory Technicians, [Wastewater
Technicians][131], and [Solar Panel Engineers][132].

They obtain their positions through various educational paths, with degrees in environmental
science, [studies][133], [policy][134], and [management][135]—emphasizing that there's more than one
path to a career in environmental science. Programs are offered at many colleges and universities in
the United States and Canada as well as throughout the world. Many students who begin in a different
major go on to pursue an environmental degree in graduate school.

## Environmental Science Degree Programs

Choosing the right school is a critical decision, as not all Environmental Science programs are
created equal. Some may be a better fit for you than others. Our comprehensive guide serves as your
compass, addressing key questions and financial aid options.

### Understanding Degree Levels

Environmental science programs span from bachelor's degrees through doctoral programs, each serving
different career goals and timelines.

### Key Factors in Choosing a Program

For comprehensive information on [environmental science degree programs][136], including bachelor's,
master's, and PhD options, explore our detailed program guides. Many students also pursue [online
environmental science degrees][137] to balance education with work or family commitments.

*Consider what matters to you:*
* In-person, online classes, or both
* Future career prospects
* Available programs and specializations

* Affordability and financial aid options
* Opportunity to collaborate with respected professors

### Finding the Right Program

When evaluating programs, consider these essential elements:

FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator dedicated to co-funding and
co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of
number of startups that we have helped, money invested and money raised. We have supported over 1620
startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

# AI-powered logistics
# for the real world

Automate your logistics from factory floor to customer door with the world's most advanced
technology platform for global trade. Flexport drives hard cost savings in your international
freight forwarding while partnering with you to build a leaner, faster supply chain.
* [Request a demo][122]

[profile-photo]

#### Hello Sofia!

Where AI-driven decision making meets real-world execution to drive logistics cost savings

### Supply Chain Visibility

Gain visibility and control over your entire global logistics network, no matter if the freight is
shipped with Flexport as the freight forwarder or managed on your direct contracts. We provide
SKU-level track-and-trace milestones for all your purchase orders, syncing the data across all your
key supply chain applications and orchestrating logistics execution all the way from factory floor
to your customer door.

### Freight Forwarding Control Tower

Drive hard cost savings with our machine learning based consolidation and routing engine for air and
ocean shippers. By consolidating your shipments in real-time as they flow out of your suppliers, we
can reduce international freight spend by an average of 10% while making sure your inventory hits
those critical must-arrive by dates.

### Customs Brokerage

Get control in a chaotic customs environment with our powerful combination of technology and
licensed customs brokers. We've saved companies over $900M in tariffs in the last 5 years through
customs entry automation, duty drawback algorithms, and trade advisory programs. Partner with us to
implement our industry leading compliance tech including our Tariff Simulator, Tariff Refund
Calculator, Product Library, and AI Compliance Auditor.

### Omnichannel Fulfillment

Ship anywhere, sell everywhere and grow faster with a single pool of inventory fulfilled from our
network of fulfillment centers. We help high growth brands achieve hard cost savings, faster
delivery, and improved working capital ratios by connecting our global logistics services directly
to our first-party e-commerce fulfillment and wholesale distribution networks.

## Our technology platform drives hard cost savings for the world’s most important companies.

> Flexport has been handling Everlane's freight forwarding and customs brokerage for quite some
> time. Our supply chain and business processes has gotten more complicated and we've needed that
> partnership in order to evolve.

[everlane logo]

Jim Green

Director of Logistics & Fulfillment, Everlane

[Homepage Split IMG-2]

Flexport Ocean Freight

## Digitize freight forwarding for visibility and control

Whether you’re shipping for the first time or moving thousands of TEUs a year, Flexport optimizes
speed and cost with world-class FCL and ocean consolidation services. What sets us apart are our
technology and our people. We digitize and structure your supply chain data, so you can track each
shipment down to the SKU, from PO creation all the way through clearance and delivery – along with
an expert team supporting you every step of the way.

[Explore Ocean Freight ][123]
[Homepage Split IMG-1]

Flexport Air Freight

## Take flight with flexible speed

Expedite your shipments with speed and precision. Our tailored solutions, including charter
services, optimize your air freight planning with live shipment updates and actionable reports – all
while keeping your costs in check. Whether you have a few critical shipments that need space or you
need to move pallets with speed, we'll deliver your goods where you need them, when you need them.

[Explore Air Freight][124]
[Homepage Split IMG-3]

Flexport Trucking

## Handle every haul with ease

Lower your operating costs across all trucking services: drayage, cartage, FTL, and LTL. Get
SKU-level visibility powered by our integrated platform, plus customized pricing through our
nationwide trucking carrier network. Let us be an extension of your transportation team, from port
to door.

[Explore Trucking ][125]
[Homepage Split IMG-4]

Flexport Fulfillment

## Fuel your growth with fast, reliable fulfillment

Flexport Fulfillment offers fast, reliable delivery nationwide with 99% on-time shipping and 97%+
on-time delivery. Our end-to-end technology and data-driven demand planning take the guesswork out
of inventory management, reducing costs and increasing efficiency. Our world-class operations and
technology have made us a logistics partner for platforms and retailers like Shopify, Walmart, and
SHEIN Marketplace.

[Explore Fulfillment ][126]

> Trek's mission is to get more people on bikes, and Flexport is integral to that goal.

[Trek logo]

Rebecca Boettcher

Director of Global Logistics, Trek

[homepage hero][homepage hero]

# AI-powered logistics
# for the real world

Automate your logistics from factory floor to customer door with the world's most advanced
technology platform for global trade. Flexport drives hard cost savings in your international
freight forwarding while partnering with you to build a leaner, faster supply chain.
* [Request a demo][122]

[profile-photo]

#### Hello Sofia!

Where AI-driven decision making meets real-world execution to drive logistics cost savings

### Supply Chain Visibility

Gain visibility and control over your entire global logistics network, no matter if the freight is
shipped with Flexport as the freight forwarder or managed on your direct contracts. We provide
SKU-level track-and-trace milestones for all your purchase orders, syncing the data across all your
key supply chain applications and orchestrating logistics execution all the way from factory floor
to your customer door.

### Freight Forwarding Control Tower

Drive hard cost savings with our machine learning based consolidation and routing engine for air and
ocean shippers. By consolidating your shipments in real-time as they flow out of your suppliers, we
can reduce international freight spend by an average of 10% while making sure your inventory hits
those critical must-arrive by dates.

### Customs Brokerage

Get control in a chaotic customs environment with our powerful combination of technology and
licensed customs brokers. We've saved companies over $900M in tariffs in the last 5 years through
customs entry automation, duty drawback algorithms, and trade advisory programs. Partner with us to
implement our industry leading compliance tech including our Tariff Simulator, Tariff Refund
Calculator, Product Library, and AI Compliance Auditor.

### Omnichannel Fulfillment

Ship anywhere, sell everywhere and grow faster with a single pool of inventory fulfilled from our
network of fulfillment centers. We help high growth brands achieve hard cost savings, faster
delivery, and improved working capital ratios by connecting our global logistics services directly
to our first-party e-commerce fulfillment and wholesale distribution networks.

## Our technology platform drives hard cost savings for the world’s most important companies.

> Flexport has been handling Everlane's freight forwarding and customs brokerage for quite some
> time. Our supply chain and business processes has gotten more complicated and we've needed that
> partnership in order to evolve.

[everlane logo]

Jim Green

Director of Logistics & Fulfillment, Everlane

[Homepage Split IMG-2]

Flexport Ocean Freight

## Digitize freight forwarding for visibility and control

Whether you’re shipping for the first time or moving thousands of TEUs a year, Flexport optimizes
speed and cost with world-class FCL and ocean consolidation services. What sets us apart are our
technology and our people. We digitize and structure your supply chain data, so you can track each
shipment down to the SKU, from PO creation all the way through clearance and delivery – along with
an expert team supporting you every step of the way.

[Explore Ocean Freight ][123]
[Homepage Split IMG-1]

Flexport Air Freight

## Take flight with flexible speed

Expedite your shipments with speed and precision. Our tailored solutions, including charter
services, optimize your air freight planning with live shipment updates and actionable reports – all
while keeping your costs in check. Whether you have a few critical shipments that need space or you
need to move pallets with speed, we'll deliver your goods where you need them, when you need them.

[Explore Air Freight][124]
[Homepage Split IMG-3]

Flexport Trucking

## Handle every haul with ease

Lower your operating costs across all trucking services: drayage, cartage, FTL, and LTL. Get
SKU-level visibility powered by our integrated platform, plus customized pricing through our
nationwide trucking carrier network. Let us be an extension of your transportation team, from port
to door.

[Explore Trucking ][125]
[Homepage Split IMG-4]

Flexport Fulfillment

## Fuel your growth with fast, reliable fulfillment

Flexport Fulfillment offers fast, reliable delivery nationwide with 99% on-time shipping and 97%+
on-time delivery. Our end-to-end technology and data-driven demand planning take the guesswork out
of inventory management, reducing costs and increasing efficiency. Our world-class operations and
technology have made us a logistics partner for platforms and retailers like Shopify, Walmart, and
SHEIN Marketplace.

[Explore Fulfillment ][126]

> Trek's mission is to get more people on bikes, and Flexport is integral to that goal.

[Trek logo]

Rebecca Boettcher

Director of Global Logistics, Trek

## **They found their suppliers in Bretagne**

*"We are a Hungarian trading company dealing with retail and wholesale of processed seafood and
seaweed products in Central Europe and highlighted in Hungary. We consciously looked for respectful
partners, who can supply us with quality products. In the internet-managed world, it might seem an
easy job to make the first contact at new territories, but it isn't. Fortunately, we have found BCI
a year ago, and it is important to mention personally Mr. Eric Vouland, who helped us a lot in
exploring Bretagne for high quality producers with success! After a year-long trust-based
partnership we have been cooperating with 7 partners from the region and we are just starting a
relation with a brand new one for our common success. Thank you Eric and BCI! We hope that our
fruitful cooperation will continue.”*
**Sandor SZEKELY**
Managing Director - IZTENGER

*"As a start-up which aims to promote international trade between France and South Korea, we called
on the services of BCI in 2019. We were looking for Breton SME interested in the Korean market at
the time. We were pleasantly surprised by the professionalism, the warm welcome and the special
attention of the BCI team. For TAM Global, BCI represents a privileged access to find serious SME
partners in Bretagne. I would highly recommend BCI to my colleagues and Korean clients. So we shall
never be disappointed."*
**‍Thomas KIM**
Managing Director - TAM GLOBAL

## Derniers dossiers de l'Ifremer

One Health : l’océan au cœur d’une seule santé
Alors que le One Health Summit réunira du 5 au 7 avril à Lyon la communauté internationale autour
d’une conviction commune - la santé des humains, des animaux, des végétaux et des écosystèmes est
indissociable - l’Ifremer rappelle que cette approche se joue aussi en mer. Qualité de l’eau,
biodiversité, santé des organismes marins, sécurité alimentaire, contaminants, antibiorésistance,
climat : dans l’océan, tout est lié. Par ses recherches, ses dispositifs d’observation et son appui
aux politiques publiques, l’institut fait de l’océan un pilier de la santé globale et développe une
approche intégrée pour mieux comprendre, surveiller et accompagner les transitions face au
changement climatique et aux pressions croissantes.
[En savoir plus][68]
L’Ifremer : une ébullition de projets pour le climat
A l’heure où la COP 30 bat une nouvelle fois le rappel de l’urgence climatique auprès de la
communauté internationale, le front de la lutte contre le réchauffement se concentre sur l’océan,
élément clé de l’équation climatique planétaire. Seul institut français de recherche publique
entièrement dédié aux sciences marines, l’Ifremer a depuis longtemps sonné la mobilisation de ses
équipes autour de cette problématique océan-climat, et orchestré la montée en puissance de sa
recherche sur cet axe prioritaire. Sur fond de météo toujours agitée, le point sur la nouvelle vague
de projets en cours…
[En savoir plus][69]
40 ans dans les abysses avec notre mythique sous-marin jaune
Mis en service en 1984, le submersible *Nautile*, l’un des fleurons de la Flotte océanographique
française opérée par l’Ifremer et sa filiale d’armement Genavir, a effectué 2122 plongées. La
première immersion à 6000 mètres de profondeur s’est déroulée le 3 avril 1985. Le sous-marin jaune
demeure l’un des acteurs majeurs de l’exploration des abysses. Seuls cinq pays au monde possèdent
aujourd’hui un sous-marin doté de telles capacités. Alors que sa mission devait s’achever en 2025,
décision a été prise de prolonger jusqu’en 2035 l’activité du seul sous-marin scientifique habité en
Europe capable d’atteindre les grands fonds.
[En savoir plus][70]
Comment se portent en 2024 les populations de poissons pêchées en France ?
Chaque année, l’Ifremer coordonne le bilan de l’évaluation, faite à l'échelle européenne, des
populations de poissons pêchés en France. Le bilan 2024 pour l’hexagone montre que 58% des volumes
de poissons débarqués dans l’hexagone en 2023 proviennent de populations exploitées durablement (non
surpêchées), contre 52% en 2022. La « surpêche » concerne 19 % des volumes des débarquements, et 2 %
proviennent de populations considérées comme « effondrées ». Depuis plusieurs années, la part de
populations non surpêchées progresse très peu et on observe une baisse de plus en plus marquée du
renouvellement des générations (moins de poissons jeunes et juvéniles), ce qui constitue un risque
de déclin de l’abondance de certaines populations.

Comment se portent en 2024 les populations de poissons pêchées en France ?
Chaque année, l’Ifremer coordonne le bilan de l’évaluation, faite à l'échelle européenne, des
populations de poissons pêchés en France. Le bilan 2024 pour l’hexagone montre que 58% des volumes
de poissons débarqués dans l’hexagone en 2023 proviennent de populations exploitées durablement (non
surpêchées), contre 52% en 2022. La « surpêche » concerne 19 % des volumes des débarquements, et 2 %
proviennent de populations considérées comme « effondrées ». Depuis plusieurs années, la part de
populations non surpêchées progresse très peu et on observe une baisse de plus en plus marquée du
renouvellement des générations (moins de poissons jeunes et juvéniles), ce qui constitue un risque
de déclin de l’abondance de certaines populations.

* How much does it cost?
  
  Subscribe for free, you will pay only and if you sell or buy, contact us for details.
* How does the insurance work?
  
  IFM is the policyholder and the members of the platform are the beneficiaries. Every member knows
  the insurance credit granted to him.
* How does the financing work?
  
  Buyers and Sellers can opt to delay payments up to 60 days or get paid immediately through IFM’s
  financing platform. Each Member looking to utilize this service will be allocated a credit limit.
* What is the LIVE Market?
  
  Through the Live market you can sell and buy your products without revealing your identity, thus
  not affecting your normal market.
* What are the OTC Trade?
  
  They are the tool through which you can record your sales / purchases, made with the normal tools
  of every day, but that through the registration on the platform, get insurance coverage, financial
  services and all the other benefits offered by IFM.
* What happens if I place an offer on IFM? Am I bound to sell it there?
  
  Absolutely not. You can withdraw your offers at any time or modify them if no transaction has
  taken place. If you execute a “LIVE MARKET” transaction, it will benefit from all the services and
  advantages offered by IFM including insurance and financial ones.

## FAQ

## Find the Answers Here
* How much does it cost?
  
  Subscribe for free, you will pay only and if you sell or buy, contact us for details.
* How does the insurance work?
  
  IFM is the policyholder and the members of the platform are the beneficiaries. Every member knows
  the insurance credit granted to him.
* How does the financing work?
  
  Buyers and Sellers can opt to delay payments up to 60 days or get paid immediately through IFM’s
  financing platform. Each Member looking to utilize this service will be allocated a credit limit.
* What is the LIVE Market?
  
  Through the Live market you can sell and buy your products without revealing your identity, thus
  not affecting your normal market.
* What are the OTC Trade?
  
  They are the tool through which you can record your sales / purchases, made with the normal tools
  of every day, but that through the registration on the platform, get insurance coverage, financial
  services and all the other benefits offered by IFM.
* What happens if I place an offer on IFM? Am I bound to sell it there?
  
  Absolutely not. You can withdraw your offers at any time or modify them if no transaction has
  taken place. If you execute a “LIVE MARKET” transaction, it will benefit from all the services and
  advantages offered by IFM including insurance and financial ones.

# Innovation for a more sustainable future

[Learn More][6]

### What We Do

Marine Biotech are revolutionizing agriculture by transforming marine waste into sustainable,
high-performance fertilizers. By harnessing the natural nutrients found in these sustainable
alternatives, we create bio-stimulants that enhance crop growth, improve soil health, and reduce
environmental impact.


These innovative solutions provide farmers with an efficient, cost-effective alternative to
traditional fertilizers, supporting a more sustainable and productive future for global agriculture.

###### Sustainable Solutions

Our approach involves creating bio-stimulant fertilizers derived from sustainable alternatives to
synthetic fertilizers.

###### Research

We investigate and develop sustainable agricultural solutions.

###### Improved Plant Growth

We use compounds that are proven effective in enhancing plant growth, strengthening root networks,
and fostering beneficial
soil microbes.

[mtb-bg.png]

##### project.

other body systems.

treat people with health problems resulting from injury or disease.

[Occupational Therapists][152] - Occupational therapy services are provided for the purpose of
promoting health and wellness and are provided to those who have or are at risk for developing an
illness, injury, disease, disorder, condition, impairment, disability, activity limitation, or
participation restriction.

is defined as the observation, description, evaluation, interpretation, and modification of human

interpersonal relationships, work and life adjustment, personal effectiveness, behavioral health,

performance of behavior health services through interpersonal communications and analysis.

registered at the clinical level in the jurisdiction of practice.

interpretation, evaluation, and implementation, initiation, monitoring or modification of medication

clinical services, prevention, advocacy, education, administration, and research in the areas of
communication and swallowing across the life span from infancy through geriatrics.

community. Our platform offers an exceptional opportunity to explore the latest breakthroughs and

seasoned professional or a budding researcher, this is a prime event to learn, share, and engage in
dynamic discussions. Join us for the [**21st International Congress on Advances in Natural
Medicines, Nutraceuticals & Neurocognition**][81], taking place on **July 14-15, 2025, in Berlin,
Germany**, under the theme:

**The Future of Neuroscience: Harmonizing Nature with Medicine to Advance Brain Health**

This prestigious two-day event will bring together leaders in science, research, and industry, with
an agenda filled with stimulating symposiums, interactive workshops, and world-class keynote
sessions. These sessions will be led by the most respected figures in the field, providing a rich
opportunity for intellectual exchange and inspiration. In addition to the formal discussions, the
conference will facilitate networking among the world’s top researchers, healthcare professionals,
and industry experts. Participants will be able to connect, collaborate, and exchange ideas with
some of the brightest minds driving innovations in the fields of [neuroscience][82], [natural
medicines][83], [nutraceuticals][84], and [cognitive health][85].

### **Key Highlights of the Conference:**
* [**Enlightening Keynote Sessions**][86]: Gain valuable insights from thought leaders in
  neuroscience and natural medicines who are advancing the frontier of brain health, cognitive
  healing, and the application of nutraceuticals.
* [**Symposiums and Workshops**][87]: Learn directly from established experts as they share their
  research findings, case studies, and cutting-edge treatments that are shaping the future of
  healthcare.
* [**Global Networking**][88]: Engage with participants from across the globe, including top
  researchers, medical professionals, industry leaders, and academic scholars. This is an
  unparalleled chance to expand your network and foster collaborations that could lead to
  groundbreaking discoveries.
* [**Opportunity for Researchers and Universities**][89]: Representatives from academic
  institutions, [universities][90], and research centers will have the chance to explore new avenues
  for collaboration with global experts in the field. This is an excellent opportunity to partner on
  future research projects or discuss innovations in the development of natural medicines and
  cognitive therapies.
* [**Business Growth and Market Expansion**][91]: For companies and entrepreneurs, this conference
  provides a unique opportunity to explore the growing market for nutraceuticals and functional
  foods. Learn about the latest consumer trends, [regulatory frameworks,][92] and potential
  opportunities for expanding your products and services on a global scale.

**Theme Overview:** The theme of the 21st International Congress, **"[The Future of Neuroscience:
Harmonizing Nature with Medicine to Advance Brain Health and Cognitive Healing][93],"** emphasizes

neuroscience has witnessed remarkable progress in understanding the brain, its functions, and its
potential for healing. This conference will explore how natural substances, such as nutraceuticals
and functional foods, can play a key role in enhancing cognitive function, supporting [brain
health][94], and even reversing cognitive decline. We will delve into the scientific mechanisms
behind these treatments and examine how they can be incorporated into modern medical practices to
create more holistic, effective solutions for [brain health][95].

### **What Are Nutraceuticals?**

Nutraceuticals are defined as food or food components that provide health benefits beyond their
basic nutritional value, including the prevention, management, and treatment of diseases. These
substances, while similar to dietary supplements, are considered to be an important addition to
traditional medical therapies. Nutraceuticals include standardized nutrients that may have a wide
range of benefits, such as promoting better brain function, enhancing memory, preventing
[neurodegenerative diseases][96], and even alleviating symptoms of stress and anxiety. These
health-promoting substances are being integrated into diets to provide better nutrition and
potentially beneficial effects beyond basic nutrition.

Nutraceuticals are not just supplements—they encompass functional foods like cereals, breads,
beverages, and other fortified products that can aid in disease prevention, [cognitive
function][97], and overall wellness. Examples include probiotics, prebiotics, plant sterols, and the
addition of vitamins or minerals to everyday food products. Functional foods are vital in preventing
chronic diseases and supporting long-term health, which is why the conference will highlight their
potential for future therapies in neurocognition and overall brain health.

### **Target Audience:**

This conference is designed for a diverse and specialized audience from across the healthcare,
academic, and business sectors. The following professionals will find immense value in attending:

  natural medicines, neuroscience, and neurocognitive therapies.
* [**Medical Colleges**][99]: Faculty and students from medical institutions who are eager to learn
  about the latest therapeutic approaches and innovations in the field.
* [**Nutraceutical Specialists**][100]: Experts in the development, application, and regulation of
  nutraceutical products aimed at improving health outcomes.
* [**Industry Professionals**][101]: Experts working in the fields of food technology,
  pharmaceuticals, and nutraceutical production who are exploring new products or research areas.
* [**Academics and Professors**:][102] Those involved in the education and training of the next
  generation of researchers and clinicians in the fields of neuroscience, nutrition, and
  pharmacology.
* [**Post-Doctoral and PhD Students**][103]: Graduate-level students specializing in neuroscience,
  nutrition, or functional foods who are looking to further their research and gain exposure to
  cutting-edge work in their field.
* [**Functional Foods Scientists**:][104] Researchers specializing in the development of functional
  foods that promote brain health, cognitive healing, and overall wellness.
* [**Food Experts and Entrepreneurs**][105]: Professionals interested in the growing market of
  functional foods and nutraceuticals, as well as entrepreneurs aiming to enter or expand in the
  field.
* [**Health and Wellness Professionals**][106]: Dietitians, nutritionists, and therapists who work
  directly with patients to improve mental and physical health.

### **Why Attend the 21st International Congress?**

The congress provides a highly valuable platform to deepen your understanding of the current state

designed to foster new ideas, ignite creative collaborations, and push the boundaries of knowledge
in this critical area of healthcare. Attendees will benefit from:
* [**World-Class Learning**][107]: Attend keynote addresses from top professionals, participate in

* [**Exposure to Latest Research**][109]: Stay at the forefront of scientific developments and gain

traditional medical therapies. Nutraceuticals include standardized nutrients that may have a wide
range of benefits, such as promoting better brain function, enhancing memory, preventing
[neurodegenerative diseases][96], and even alleviating symptoms of stress and anxiety. These
health-promoting substances are being integrated into diets to provide better nutrition and
potentially beneficial effects beyond basic nutrition.

Nutraceuticals are not just supplements—they encompass functional foods like cereals, breads,
beverages, and other fortified products that can aid in disease prevention, [cognitive
function][97], and overall wellness. Examples include probiotics, prebiotics, plant sterols, and the
addition of vitamins or minerals to everyday food products. Functional foods are vital in preventing
chronic diseases and supporting long-term health, which is why the conference will highlight their
potential for future therapies in neurocognition and overall brain health.

### **Target Audience:**

This conference is designed for a diverse and specialized audience from across the healthcare,
academic, and business sectors. The following professionals will find immense value in attending:
* [**Research Heads**:][98] Leaders in scientific research who are driving the advancements in
  natural medicines, neuroscience, and neurocognitive therapies.
* [**Medical Colleges**][99]: Faculty and students from medical institutions who are eager to learn
  about the latest therapeutic approaches and innovations in the field.
* [**Nutraceutical Specialists**][100]: Experts in the development, application, and regulation of
  nutraceutical products aimed at improving health outcomes.
* [**Industry Professionals**][101]: Experts working in the fields of food technology,
  pharmaceuticals, and nutraceutical production who are exploring new products or research areas.
* [**Academics and Professors**:][102] Those involved in the education and training of the next
  generation of researchers and clinicians in the fields of neuroscience, nutrition, and
  pharmacology.
* [**Post-Doctoral and PhD Students**][103]: Graduate-level students specializing in neuroscience,
  nutrition, or functional foods who are looking to further their research and gain exposure to
  cutting-edge work in their field.
* [**Functional Foods Scientists**:][104] Researchers specializing in the development of functional
  foods that promote brain health, cognitive healing, and overall wellness.
* [**Food Experts and Entrepreneurs**][105]: Professionals interested in the growing market of
  functional foods and nutraceuticals, as well as entrepreneurs aiming to enter or expand in the
  field.
* [**Health and Wellness Professionals**][106]: Dietitians, nutritionists, and therapists who work
  directly with patients to improve mental and physical health.

### **Why Attend the 21st International Congress?**

The congress provides a highly valuable platform to deepen your understanding of the current state
and future directions of nutraceuticals, natural medicines, and neurocognitive research. It is
designed to foster new ideas, ignite creative collaborations, and push the boundaries of knowledge
in this critical area of healthcare. Attendees will benefit from:
* [**World-Class Learning**][107]: Attend keynote addresses from top professionals, participate in
  thought-provoking symposiums, and engage in hands-on workshops designed to expand your knowledge
  of cutting-edge treatments and innovations.
* [**Networking Opportunities**][108]: Meet fellow professionals, exchange ideas, and form valuable
  connections that could lead to future collaborations, partnerships, or research opportunities.
* [**Exposure to Latest Research**][109]: Stay at the forefront of scientific developments and gain
  access to the most recent studies, clinical trials, and technological advancements that are
  shaping the field.

# 1949

# 1949

The Gjendemsjø family has been innovative for generations. It all started in 1949 when Lauritz
decided to be a fisherman instead of taking over his family farm. Since then, he was a fisherman by
heart. He later became a pioneer by building the first fishing boat designed with thrusters. In the
late 60's, Lauritz wanted to take things to a new level and increase the value of the fish they
caught. This was the beginning of a wonderful adventure that he shared with his son Leif Kjetil.

# 1974

# 1974

As a young child Leif Kjetil wanted to help his father and at the age of 8 he started his career
cutting cod tongues in his father`s fish processing-factory and selling them as delicacy to
relatives and neighbors. He learned early that we should only harvest what we need and utilize
everything we harvest from nature. This has become a mantra that he have brought with him ever
since.

# 1982

Growing up, Leif Kjetil used to help out at the factory after school, and as his father he also fell
in love with the profession. As he grew older he was driving along the Norwegian coast selling fish

in Norway. Leif Kjetil and his team changed the factory from being a cod liver oil factory to become
one of the first factories in the world to produce omega-3 concentrates.

Napro Pharma.

# 2006

# 2007

Production Officer) and Martin Frostad (Chief Technical Officer), have been working with omega-3

well together. They are probably the most experienced team in the industry.

# 2008

# 2008

It was very important for Pharma Marine™ that the new product would be from sustainable raw
materials and we wanted to bring something new to the omega-3 market. The idea about omega-3 oil
from squid was born in 2007, and in 2009 the first batch with CalaMarine® was produced. This product
became the first omega-3 concentrates in the world made from trimmings of food production of squid.

# 2011

# 2011

In 2011 Pharma Marine™ saw the need of being able to offer customers the more classic type of fish
oil from anchovies, sardines and mackerel and launched the ingredient line LipidMarine™. This is a
line with a wide range of high quality EPA and DHA oils with a great sensory profile.

# 2014

# 2014

Leif Kjetil had for a long time had a dream about using the trimmings, not only the liver, from
Norwegian fishing boats to produce omega-3 oils. Being from a fisher family he knew very well that
the fishermen were looking for ways to utilize the trimmings of food production of wild-caught fish.
When the knowledgeable and innovative Norwegian fisheries invested in production of fish oil and
fish meal onboard the fishing vessels – they became the perfect supplier and partner for Pharma
Marine. As a result of this, CodMarine® was launched in 2014. Because of this collaboration with the
local fisheries the CodMarine® – products has a tracing system, making it possible for the consumer
to trace their oil back to the fishing vessel and the area the fish was caught.

# 2016

# 2016

After a lot of thinking and experimenting about how we could help consumers increase their omega-3
intake, GourmetMarine™ was developed in 2016. Knowing that not all consumers want to take liquid oil
on a spoon or soft gels, we wanted to find a way to help more people get omega-3 in their diet. By
formulating premium quality omega-3 oil with healthy vegetable oils we are able to provide consumers
with a delicious oil they can use on their food. With GourmetMarine™ we hope to inspire more people
to get omega-3 in to their diet. We continue to develop our technologies and methods to be sure we
always supply our customers with an oil with superior sensory profile that is optimized for both our
products and the consumers. In the end of 2016 we installed a specially developed liquid bottling
line so we can offer our customers finished product with unique formulations bottled at our facility
in Norway.

# 2018

# 2018

We installed a new machine in 2018 for filling oil in sachets. This new delivery form will make it
more convenient for the consumers to get their daily dosage in a single package, and for them to
bring fresh oil on travels or just out for lunch. It is also the perfect delivery form for Pharma
Marine`s customers to use for sampling.

# 2020

# 2020

Pharma Marine always work to provide premium products that makes it convenient for everyone to get
their daily dosage of the important omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA), that is why we launched a
plant based product in 2020. VegMarine™ is a product line with superior sensory profile oils
produced from sustainable micro algae in closed and sterile systems.

# 2024

# 2024

We are proud of Pharma Marine being a family business with family values at its core. We believe in
close relationships with our partners, our employees, and our local community. And, of course, an
enduring respect for nature. Outside our doorstep on Terøy, there is a vast sea of possibilities.
For our planet, our health, and future generations.

# **Innovating Today. Sustaining Tomorrow.**

Quintessence Chemsolutions LLP is a global R&D-centric chemical solutions company focused on
developing innovative, customized, and technology-driven solutions for the food industry, health &
nutraceutical sector, and sustainable bio-fuels market.
